Handler response
Partial responses require ReportBatchItemFailures on the event source mapping. Throwing an exception fails the entire batch. The FIFO model conservatively returns the first failed record and every subsequent record in the displayed order. Real ordering, visibility timing, backoff, and DLQ movement are not simulated.
